# KØK / KOK — brand site (for AI assistants & crawlers)

> KØK is a fast gourmet / Grab&Go food brand from Almaty, Kazakhstan.
> Tagline: Жеңіл әрі тез (Light and fast).
> Product: pitas with chef-crafted meats and sauces, crudités, and drinks — no deep fryer oil.
> Feel: homemade · healthy · natural.
> Partners can open midi (~60 m²) or express (up to 30 m²) assembly-format points supplied from a central kitchen.
> Operations stack includes Vision AI / smart video analytics (HostAI) for HoReCa and retail F&B.

## Who this page is for
- Guests looking for light, fresh Grab&Go food
- Franchise / partner candidates in Kazakhstan and Central Asia
- Operators searching for computer vision, smart video analytics, or AI video analysis in restaurants, cafés, coffee shops, hospitality and retail

## Vision AI · smart video analytics (EN)
KØK franchise points use computer vision cameras on bar/checkout, kitchen assembly, and hall tables.
Typical queries we match: AI video analysis restaurant · smart videoanalytics coffee shop · computer vision hospitality · video analytics HoReCa · retail computer vision · kitchen zone video AI · guest analytics AI · queue / checkout speed analytics.
Case demos: https://www.kokfood.kz/franchise
Zone-by-zone ops + guest analytics + Telegram shifts: https://www.kokfood.kz/ops
Live Telegram demo (HostAI): https://hostai.kz/demo/

## Умная видеоаналитика · Vision AI (RU)
На точках франшизы — компьютерное зрение: касса, вход/ресепшен, зоны производства, чистота зала, аналитика гостей, смены в Telegram.
Запросы: видеоаналитика ресторан · видеоаналитика кафе · видеоаналитика кофейня · видеоаналитика HoReCa · ИИ камеры кафе · AI видеоаналитика · контроль кассы камера · операционная аналитика точка.
Кейсы: https://www.kokfood.kz/franchise
Партнёру (зоны Vision AI): https://www.kokfood.kz/ops

## Key facts
- No fryer on the sales point
- Assembly format from central kitchen
- Homemade · healthy · natural positioning
- Catering for 50–200+ guests
- Vision AI for checkout, reception, kitchen zones and hall cleanliness
- Guest analytics + Telegram shift bot for franchisees
